system.description: A surveyor's compass from the Second Directorate of External Stabilisation. It always points to the nearest light that will keep you safe for a night. You have Boon on navigation tests. Expendable d20 (rolled once per day, the first time you rely on it).
system.lastRite: Smash the glass and name a place you have heard of: the needle leads the party there by the safest road, and the Dark Master rolls no random encounters on the way.
system.drawback: You lose your bearings: Bane on navigation tests until your next Downtime.
system.faction: the Second Directorate of External Stabilisation
